## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

---

### 1. 本季度收入同比增长 32%

**计算过程：**

| 项目 | FY26 Q4（2026年4–6月） | FY25 Q4（2025年4–6月） | 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Intelligent Cloud 收入 | $39,306 百万 | $29,878 百万 | financial_statements.txt"Segment Results"工作表 |

**计算公式：**

同比增长率 = (39,306 − 29,878) ÷ 29,878 × 100 = 9,428 ÷ 29,878 × 100 ≈ 31.55%

Microsoft 在 press_release.txt 中将结果四舍五入表述为 **32%**（按报告口径 GAAP），按恒定汇率口径为 **31%**（原文："Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"）。

---

### 2. 管理层在电话会上把增长归因于哪些因素（原文引用）

**归因 A — Azure 43% 增长（核心驱动力）**

Amy Hood 在 prepared remarks 中说：

> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."

（transcript.txt 第 20,000–40,000 字符区间，Amy Hood 关于 Intelligent Cloud 的段落）

**归因 B — 服务器业务相对平稳**

> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."

**归因 C — 整体分部利润率与运营效率**

> "Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure."

> "Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier. Operating income grew 31% and operating margins, with a strong focus on efficiencies and investment returns, were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%."

**归因 D — 资本支出与产能扩张（Satya Nadella 角度）**

> "We added 31 new datacenters across 5 continents this quarter, bringing the total to 88 this year, as we expand our footprint in response to accelerating demand."

> "All up, we added another gigawatt of capacity this quarter and remain on track to roughly double our overall capacity in just two years."

---

### 3. 逐条标注：已发生事实 vs. 前瞻性表述

| # | 归因内容 | 性质 | 判定依据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" | **已发生事实（对当前季度状态的描述）** | 使用现在进行时"continues to exceed"，描述截至本季末的供需状态；Amy Hood 在回应 Brent Thill 提问时也确认"there are still constraints in the system… demand continues to exceed available supply" |
| A2 | "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet" | **已发生事实** | "was ahead of expectations" 是对已关闭季度的回溯性评估；"efficiency gains…were quickly monetized" 中的"were quickly monetized"指本季已变现 |
| A3 | "process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity… that additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized" | **已发生事实** | "in-quarter capacity"指本季内已上线的产能，"was quickly monetized"为过去式，描述已发生的变现 |
| A4 | "stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change" | **已发生事实** | "following the June business model change"指已发生的6月定价模式变更，"consumption"是本季实际观察到的消费数据 |
| A5 | "on-premises server business… Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts" | **已发生事实** | "were ahead of expectations"回溯性评估；"renewals"指已完成的续约 |
| A6 | "demand continues to exceed available supply… when we can make efficiency gains, they are quickly monetized in quarter" | **混合：当前事实 + 未来机制** | 前半句"continues to exceed"是事实描述；后半句"when we can make efficiency gains, they are quickly monetized in quarter"是**前瞻性**的——它陈述的是一个预期会持续发生的运作机制（"when we can"暗示未来仍会发生） |
| A7 | "even with the strong close to Q4, we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | **前瞻性表述** | "we continue to expect"是明确的未来展望用语；"H1 growth to accelerate"指向FY27上半年 |
| A8 | "year-over-year Azure growth rates can vary quarter-to-quarter based on capacity timing and contract mix" | **前瞻性表述（风险提示）** | "can vary"指出未来季度可能的变化，属免责声明 |
| A9 | "we added another gigawatt of capacity this quarter and remain on track to roughly double our overall capacity in just two years" | **混合** | "added this quarter"是已发生事实；"remain on track to roughly double"是**前瞻性**目标 |
| A10 | "Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier" | **已发生事实** | "increased"是已完成季度的实际数字；但若联系 Satya 关于"grind work… you just get a little better"的表述（"this is the grind work"），则是对**持续性未来投入**的暗示，属于前瞻性 |

**判定依据总结：**
- **已发生事实**：使用过去式或完成时态（"grew""was""were""increased""added"），描述已关闭季度的实际数据、已完成的续约、已变现的产能。
- **前瞻性表述**：使用"expect""continue to expect""will""can""remain on track to"等模态动词，或描述持续机制（"when we can… they are quickly monetized"），指向未来季度的预测、目标或免责声明。
- **混合项**：同一句中既包含已确认数据，又包含对未来运作方式的陈述（如 A6、A9）。

---

| Azure 43% 增长及归因（需求超供给、效率、流程改进、GitHub Copilot） | transcript.txt Amy Hood prepared remarks（20k–40k 区间） |
